scope: Recorded project sources, supplied development reading, implementation credits and bundled notices. A citation does not imply copied code or endorsement.

entries.title: VIRTUALPCR/MISSYR2
entries.use: Source code for this workbench, configuration, simulator, export and integration.

entries.title: MISSY and zpcrweb
entries.use: Bundled MISSY analysis page; graph interaction and presentation ancestry. Workbench graph behaviour was independently reimplemented.
entries.credit: GPL-3.0 attribution recorded in project notices; retain upstream notices.

entries.title: RDML Consortium
entries.use: Structured real-time PCR exchange format. RDMLt is this project’s draft telemetry package around an RDML core; it is not presented as a consortium standard.

entries.title: GMOMETHODS — EURL GMFF / European Commission JRC
entries.use: Assay records, oligonucleotide sequences, reaction conditions, method performance and validation references.
entries.credit: © European Union; acknowledgement retained. Individual DOI references are listed below.

entries.title: JRC GMO-Matrix
entries.use: Element/event relationships used by the teaching scenarios.

entries.title: JRC136933 — Bioinformatics evaluation of GMO reference genes and their amplification systems
entries.use: Reference-gene copy-number and amplicon information; report identifier recorded in the original construction notes.

entries.title: MARA 1012 method series and explanatory translations
entries.use: Source-referenced draft method calculations, control rules and interpretation profiles. Published Chinese standards remain authoritative; local explanatory translations are supporting material.
entries.credit: The bundled profiles retain source PDF names, clause references and SHA-256 identifiers. Laboratory approval is separate from these teaching profiles.

entries.title: Gevertz, J. L.; Dunn, S. M.; Roth, C. M. (2005). Mathematical model of real-time PCR kinetics. Biotechnology and Bioengineering 92:346–355.
entries.use: User-supplied development reading for amplification kinetics and curve-shape review; not a claim that every model equation was adopted.

entries.title: Zhao, S.; Fernald, R. D. (2005). Comprehensive Algorithm for Quantitative Real-Time Polymerase Chain Reaction. Journal of Computational Biology 12:1047–1064.
entries.use: User-supplied development reading for exponential-phase analysis and fluorescence-curve fitting.

entries.title: Adams, G. (2020). A beginner’s guide to RT-PCR, qPCR and RT-qPCR. The Biochemist 42(3):48–53.
entries.use: User-supplied introductory reading for molecular-biology and qPCR teaching content.

entries.title: Vandesompele et al. (2002). Accurate normalization of real-time quantitative RT-PCR data by geometric averaging of multiple internal control genes. Genome Biology 3:research0034.
entries.use: geNorm M reference recorded in the project acknowledgements.

entries.title: PCR-Calculator — S. Gil
entries.use: Inspiration for reaction counts, excess, master-mix strength, rounded totals and copyable mix reports. No code copied.
entries.credit: No licence stated in the original project review; idea-only reuse.

entries.title: Auto-qPCR — Maussion, Thomas, Demirova et al. (2021)
entries.use: Adapted example files, replicate cut-off behaviour and default-settings reference.
entries.credit: GPL-3.0 recorded in project notices; example instrument labels were made neutral.

entries.title: Click-qPCR — Kubota and Tajima (2025)
entries.use: Reproduced template example and comparative ΔCq/ΔΔCq analysis with Welch t-test.
entries.credit: The project notices record MIT for the software; the article has its own publication licence.

entries.title: qPCR plate planner — M. M. Ali
entries.use: Reproduced mixed plate JSON example in the file-analysis examples.
entries.credit: CC BY-NC 4.0 recorded in the existing notices; exact source revision was not retained.

entries.title: rtpcr / shiny_rtpcr — Ghader Mirzaghaderi
entries.use: Reference for efficiency/Ct columns and efficiency weighting; workbench example values were constructed locally.

entries.title: PCRtools and virtualPCR — R. Kalendar
entries.use: Tm definitions, reaction conditions and primer-pairing concepts; independent implementation, no source code copied.
entries.credit: GPL-3.0 reference recorded in construction notices.

entries.title: Chai Open qPCR
entries.use: Reference for sensor curves, protocol options and Cy0 behaviour.
entries.credit: Apache-2.0 recorded in original project acknowledgements. Specific revision was not retained.

entries.title: Plotly.js basic distribution 2.35.2
entries.use: Inlined interactive plotting library in the bundled MISSY page.
entries.credit: MIT; bundled comments and upstream notices remain in missy/index.html.

entries.title: D3 formatting modules within Plotly

entries.credit: See the inlined Plotly distribution for its full dependency notices.

entries.title: Instrument-export summary statistics and fitted curve profiles
entries.use: The original review records 730 run files for curve-shape/control-variation summaries. The model also retains 71 late P-35S profile shapes. These private source records have no public dataset URL.
entries.credit: Model summaries are distinct from the user’s experiment files. No private local paths or raw run exports are published here.

entries.title: Virtual control-chart histories
entries.use: Built-in simulated teaching histories derived from local instrument-record summaries. These are training examples, not new real instrument experiments.

entries.title: Books and other supplied assets
entries.use: No named book citation is documented in the available construction notes or distributed source. Supplied Fritzing parts were development references; no copied Fritzing asset is identified in this runtime package. This list does not assign an invented author, book or repository.

entries.title: Supplied MISSY voice-interview prototype
entries.use: User-supplied prototype 0.1.0 adapted to the live batch schema, shared drafts, local-only speech adapter and MISSY-style panels. Its original code notice identifies the workbench licence; no Scratch GUI/editor code is included.

entries.title: On-device Web Speech API
entries.use: Browser-managed English pack availability/installation and mandatory local recognition. Recognition support depends on the browser. Typed and tap input work without speech.
entries.credit: API documentation only; no remote recognition service or third-party recognition library bundled.
